notes: stage 3 compensation of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, no capture of its own: ladder (capture-1, rail-1, low-1, refs of sittings 1, 6, 7), the six run-up sets, sag/capture-1, pot-table's camera blocks of sitting 9 and load/lift-1 and load/ladder-1 re-read from raw. The constants from the stage 3, stage 1 and type results named in constants_used, copper's 0.39 %/C typed. Speeds in motor rev/s. The free ladder is scored by repeat (the brush table from two repeats, the third scored), every other set on the table from every ladder spin. Truths, the ripple tach (ladder, refs, holds, sag), the order-tracked count (run-ups), the tag through the gear over 100 ms (clips), the pot through the table (lift). A band holds windows by the truth's speed, mean +/- se, sd, rms in rev/s and %. V_b tables are X's rung means per direction at 50 rev/s knots, flat under the lowest rung, null past the top + 25 rev/s, clipped at zero except the signed ones. The product form is fitted on the ladder and the run-ups (run-ups weighted as 100 spins). The pot windows tile held segments from 150 ms in, half-overlapping. hold_pos_sd_counts from load/ladder-1 alone (sitting 1). The closing table lists what the data ask of a firmware.
estimate_form: i_w = (crest - awake zero) / counts_per_a - g (1 - D) V_on; V_c = s V_on - (1 - s) (b0 + b1 i_w); E = V_c - V0 - R(T) i_w - k_d rate - V_b(w, dir); w = E / Ke, one root by bisection on V_b. At 100 % s = 1, no brake, no reading term, and - L di/dt.
